'''Macchbraus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] who lived in a small camp on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. No longer loyal to his fellow [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Marauders]], Macchbraus divulged his ancestors secret armor designs to a skilled [[armorsmith]] sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Macchbraus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
